name: RealFi USDrf
oneLiner: USDrf is RealFi's Cardano dollar token backed by off-chain credit, with a Treasury liquidity buffer and institution-only direct redemption.
collateral: Off-chain Treasury bills, money market funds, floating-rate credit, CLO ETFs and private credit; published allocation ranges describe strategy rather than verified current holdings.
pegMechanism: Whitelisted institutions mint and redeem through a human-approved FIFO queue with daily and monthly limits. Retail exits depend on secondary markets. Protocol first-loss reserves and the junior sUSDrf tranche absorb losses before USDrf.
launchPhaseDetail: RealFi launched USDrf, a dollar token backed by off-chain credit, and its junior staked token sUSDrf on Cardano mainnet on October 1 2026. Supply was 5,403,937 USDrf on Cardano on November 1 2026. Direct minting and redemption are limited to whitelisted institutions under an Institutional Minting Agreement, through a human-approved first-in-first-out queue with daily and monthly limits. Retail holders exit by trading on decentralized exchanges. RealFi's docs name TxPipe, Anastasia Labs and Halborn as auditors and HT Digital as reserve attestation provider, but no audit report or attestation had been published by November 1 2026. On November 8 2026 CoinGecko's realfi-usdrf listing carried a fresh price near $1 and a market cap of about $5.1 million. DefiLlama 445 still applies a fill price shared by over 100 list assets, which puts its list supply at about $299 against 5.41 million tokens, so Pharos keeps USDrf pre-launch until the row moves to CoinGecko's supplemental route and completes its Mint Authority and admission reviews.

milestones.title: RealFi introduces USDr and its staked sUSDr
milestones.description: RealFi's introductory post presents USDr as the protocol's stablecoin and sUSDr as its staked layer. The Cardano asset still carries the on-chain name USDr, while RealFi now brands it USDrf.

milestones.title: RealFi announces testnet phase 1 opening July 6
milestones.description: RealFi announced that phase 1 of its testnet would go live on July 6 2026, with testnet tokens carrying no monetary value.

milestones.title: RealFi launches on Cardano mainnet
milestones.description: RealFi announced its Cardano mainnet launch with USDrf and the junior staked token sUSDrf.
